mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_account_content ( content_id, account_id, task_id, platform, content_type, content_title, content_text, original_url, publish_time, capture_time, risk_level, sentiment, keywords, like_count, comment_count, share_count, collect_count, view_count, raw_data, clue_id, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{contentId}, #{accountId}, #{taskId}, #{platform}, #{contentType}, #{contentTitle}, #{contentText}, #{originalUrl}, #{publishTime}, #{captureTime}, #{riskLevel}, #{sentiment}, #{keywords}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{collectCount}, #{viewCount}, #{rawData}, #{clueId}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, content_id, account_id, task_id, platform, content_type, content_title, content_text, original_url, publish_time, capture_time, risk_level, sentiment, keywords, like_count, comment_count, share_count, collect_count, view_count, raw_data, clue_id, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time FROM campus_account_content WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
